# Send Email

The Apify actor [`apify/send-mail`](https://apify.com/apify/send-mail) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.3.21**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Send a custom email to one or more recipients. This Actor is useful for notifications and reporting. It can be invoked directly from code or via webhook integration after another Actor finishes.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/send-mail) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-send-mail@0.3.21#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      to: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `to` | string | yes |  | To — Email address of the recipient(s), you can comma-separate multiple addresses. |
| `cc` | string |  |  | Cc — Email CC same format as to. |
| `bcc` | string |  |  | Bcc — Email BCC same format as to. |
| `subject` | string | yes |  | Subject — (required) Text body of Email |
| `text` | string |  |  | Text — (required HTML or text) Text body of Email |
| `html` | string |  |  | HTML — (required HTML or text) HTML body of Email |
| `replyTo` | string |  |  | Reply to — Email address which will be set when recipient will try to reply to mail. Uses header Reply-To see doc |
| `isMock` | boolean |  | `false` | Mock email — For test purposes - log process to console but not send the e-mail |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
